_comment: 🔒️ Repo-wide shrink-only test-migration ratchet, kept beside 🔒️dependencies.json because it is repository state rather than any module's state. `unmanagedTests` counts executable test files that still live outside the canonical owner-root test tree, keyed by the AREA they sit in (`areas` in 🔣️taxonomy.json). The contract phase fails when a count grows; an area that is deleted simply surveys as zero and passes. Per-owner migration status is NOT here — it lives with each owner, in that owner's own 🧪️oracle manifest.
